svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-empire-org; chart type: org_architecture; title: One full-time architect, three specialized contractors; subtitle: Illustrative 4-person ($425k-$800k/yr) portfolio pod; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not FTE salaries. All contractor work requires signed IP assignment.; caption: Keep headcount lean by automating fulfillment, tax, and Tier-1 FAQ triage while focusing human talent on SKU quality and creative velocity.; stages: label: Owner / product architect; value: 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Owns market selection, offer positioning, pricing, funnel math, and capital allocation.; label: Product & UI builder; value: 1 C; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Builds modular Notion/Sheets/Figma systems, calculators, and micro-extension updates under written IP assignment.; label: Video & ad editor; value: 1 C; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Produces faceless YouTube tutorials, VSL hooks, and weekly Meta/TikTok creative variants.; label: Ops & affiliate lead; value: 1 C; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Manages Tier-2 customer tickets, refund QA, DMCA sweeps, and affiliate/newsletter partner payouts.
